verdict.rationale: Navan documents a partner-gated REST Expense API and a hosted MCP server, but nothing in the evidence shows an official client SDK in any language. The API reference consists of static curl/Node examples, and there is no OpenAPI spec from which SDKs could be generated. A raw REST API and an MCP endpoint are building blocks and adjacent surfaces, not official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
